name: What is the typical timeline for new home construction?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeline for new home construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for new home construction varies based on factors such as home size, complexity, permits, and weather. Generally, a custom home can take anywhere from 8 to 18 months from groundbreaking to move-in. This includes phases like foundation pouring, framing, rough-ins for electrical and plumbing, drywall installation, finishing work, and final inspections. Delays can occur due to unforeseen site conditions or material availability, so flexibility is key.
acceptedAnswer.description: New home construction typically takes 8 to 18 months, depending on size, complexity, and permits. This includes various construction phases and inspections.
